legend: You are given a symbol $S$ and $N$ numbers. For each number $X_i$, print a line with $S$ repeated $X_i$ times.
input: The first line contains the symbol $S$, one of \texttt{+}, \texttt{-}, \texttt{*}, \texttt{/}. The second line contains $N$ ($1 \le N \le 50$). The third line contains $N$ integers $X_i$ ($1 \le X_i \le 100$).
notes: Do not print spaces after the symbols.
